# CSI2 differential fixture

`stage1_encoder_v2.csi2` was generated by compiling
`stage1_fixture_generator.cpp` against the actual Stage-1
`udp_protocol.cpp`/`.h` as present at the pre-localization Stage-2 commit
`10adb198bc0a450e8906ac47f8dd4a14ab50c352`:

```bash
c++ -std=c++17 -I/path/to/MtkCSIdump-csi \
  stage1_fixture_generator.cpp /path/to/MtkCSIdump-csi/udp_protocol.cpp \
  -o /tmp/stage1-fixture-gen
/tmp/stage1-fixture-gen > stage1_encoder_v2.csi2
```

The protocol files are unchanged from the Stage-1 encoder, while the recorded
repository revision also contains later Stage-2 capture gates. The fixture and
exact encoder source hashes are sealed in
`stage1_encoder_v2.provenance.json`. Tests verify the fixture hash and every
important decoded field. It is a deterministic protocol vector, not a real CSI
capture and contains no private transmitter data.
